title: EUROPA RUN — Jump Across Europe | Hackathon Game
metaDescription: A mobile-friendly pixel-art endless runner. Jump through 20 European cities, collect postcards and compete on the shared hackathon leaderboard.
bodyText: EUROPARUN Jump Across Europe Pixel-art endless runner — jump across six European cities, collect postcards, top the leaderboard ▶ PLAY Best: 0 You: SpeedyMole20 Postcards: 0/6 My Postcards Leaderboard Join the public hackathon leaderboard. Your best score may be shown under your generated nickname (SpeedyMole20). No name, email or location is collected. You can opt out anytime without losing access to the game.
